question.prompt: The sum of three consecutive even numbers is 78. What is the largest of these even numbers?

solutions.explanation: Let the middle even number be \(x\). Then the other two are \(x-2\) and \(x+2\). Setting up the equation \((x-2)+x+(x+2)=78\) gives \(x=26\), so the largest number is 28.
solutions.title: Middle-number equation
